statements.proposition: This change keeps backward compatibility by falling back to the old 'docker run' container method when Docker Compose is not used.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: The diff removes the old 'docker run' code paths and adds code that explicitly refuses to fall back. In test/harness.ts, 'No fallback - if the image isn't in docker-compose, it should fail', followed by a throw of 'All test containers must use docker-compose.'. In test/js/valkey/test-utils.ts, Redis startup throws 'Docker Compose is required' on failure. The only remaining 'Fallback to old method' branches in test-utils.ts look up or restart an existing container by name when dockerComposeInfo is unset; they never start a container with 'docker run'. No added code starts containers the old way (the only added 'docker run' strings are examples in test/docker/README.md). The label depends on reading code, not on running it.
evidence: test/harness.ts patch: removed 'cmd: [docker, "run", "--rm", "-dPit", ...]'; added '// No fallback - if the image isn't in docker-compose, it should fail' and throw new Error(`Image ... is not configured in docker-compose.yml. All test containers must use docker-compose.`)

test/js/valkey/test-utils.ts patch: removed 'docker run' startup; added throw new Error(`Docker Compose is required. Redis container failed to start via docker-compose: ...`); the 'Fallback to old method' comments are only in getRedisContainerName/restartRedisContainer (docker ps / docker restart)
grep over all patches for added 'docker run' / '"run"': only test/docker/README.md example lines
